description.content:
The Tripadvisor Content API provides developers with access to Tripadvisor's extensive dataset of more than 7.5 million locations, 1 billion reviews and opinions, and content in 29 languages. The API includes endpoints for location search, nearby search, location details, location photos, and location reviews, enabling developers to integrate rich travel content into their websites and applications. Locations are defined within this API as hotels, restaurants, or attractions. The first 5,000 API calls per month are free for initial development and testing.
